_note: Mocombe mega-menu hover-preview clips. Keys are the EXACT video paths site-addons.js expects (/Images/mega/<sect>/<slug>.mp4). REVISED 2026-07-21: prompts are now FACE-FREE / atmospheric b-roll. LTX-Video reliably melts and duplicates human faces at this scale, so we avoid faces-in-focus entirely (hands, homes, objects, wide/distant/silhouette shots). This is also better brand imagery for a small looping preview pane.

_render._why: 768x576 = 4:3 (matches site-addons.js .mega-preview-media aspect-ratio 4/3, object-fit cover), both dims divisible by 32 as LTX requires. Higher res + 40 steps (up from 30) buys temporal coherence, reducing warping. A100 renders this in well under a minute each.

_style_suffix: cinematic b-roll, soft natural lighting, shallow depth of field, warm and trustworthy tone, gentle slow camera motion, premium and elegant, 4k, no text, no logos, no visible faces
